rows.notes: Released mission title reused from missions_019.json (slot 190); style matches other lettered-mission scenes (e.g. 4003100 '10A Defend Amaterasu').

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>I know you've only now returned, but I will get straight to it - I have bad news. <color(5)>Char Aznable<ce()><thumbnail(238)> has finally made his move.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>While you were away, <book(12)>Neo Zeon<endbook()> seized the space colony "<book(17)>Sweetwater<endbook()>".
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>And mere moments ago, the <book(12)>Neo Zeon<endbook()> fleet left <book(17)>Sweetwater<endbook()> and is said to be heading for <book(13)>5th Luna<endbook()>.
rows.notes: '5th Luna' kept in digit form per 4004583.json precedent. Avoided 'just' (no j glyph).

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>It seems <color(5)>Char<ce()> means to seize it and drop it on Earth.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>If, as <color(5)>Char<ce()> intends, <book(13)>5th Luna<endbook()> is dropped, Earth's environment will suffer catastrophic damage.
rows.notes: Reordered clause so the Char/5th Luna tag order matches the source (Char mentioned before 5th Luna).

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>The blast smoke and dust thrown up by the fall will block out the sun... A "nuclear winter<thumbnail(239)>" will result!
rows.notes: <thumbnail> kept directly after 'winter', before the closing quote, as in the source.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>To stop this terrible scheme with everything we have, the <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> forces have already dispatched a fleet.

<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Naturally, I meant to have you take part too, but the timing could not be worse... <color(5)>Sakomizu<ce()><thumbnail(209)>'s army has appeared at <book(15)>Lhasa<endbook()>.
rows.notes: Compressed to fit 128; 'take part too' refers back to the fleet operation mentioned just before. 'Sakomizu's army' matches the phrasing in 4003661.json. Lhasa locked (encyclopedia_022 / 4003090). 'join' reworded to 'take part' (no lowercase j).

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>They are a force from another world. Ever since they appeared, they have kept attacking <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> facilities everywhere.

<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>What's more, in league with <book(12)>Neo Zeon<endbook()>, a former <book(18)>Giganos<endbook()> force has also launched an invasion. <book(15)>Lhasa<endbook()> is on the verge of falling.
rows.notes: 'former Giganos' matches character_names_021 convention. Reordered so Neo Zeon precedes Giganos, matching the source tag order.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>This crisis leaves <book(10)>Londo Bell<endbook()> with a single order<thumbnail(240)>: defend <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> HQ's home, <book(15)>Lhasa<endbook()>.
rows.notes: Londo Bell (not 'Rondo Bell') per glossary.json/character_names_021.json/encyclopedia_021_a.json. Restructured so tag order (Londo Bell, thumbnail, Federation, Lhasa) matches the source exactly.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Because the <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> forces have committed most of their strength to <book(13)>5th Luna<endbook()>, our home base has been left thin on defense.
rows.notes: 'honmaru' (castle keep) rendered 'home base' - no locked term found; descriptive.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>If our home base falls, the <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> will take a devastating blow. We cannot let this stand.
rows.notes: 'honmaru' again rendered 'home base', consistent with slot 30.

rows.en: <thumbdown()><operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Leave <book(13)>5th Luna<endbook()> to the <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> forces. I want you to remain on the ground and defend <book(15)>Lhasa<endbook()>.
<topic()><operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Also, starting with this operation, <color(4)>Asap Suzuki<ce()><thumbnail(241)> has agreed to cooperate with us as well.
rows.notes: Honorific -kun dropped per project convention (cf. -san dropped in 4003070). Asap Suzuki per character_names_021 (char.asap_suzuki, locked).

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>He is a civilian who came back from <book(36)>Byston Well<endbook()> to stop <color(5)>Sakomizu<ce()>.
rows.notes: Byston Well locked (glossary.json loc.byston_well). 'Sakomizu' here = King (Shinjiro) Sakomizu, male per character_names_021.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>He is also personally familiar with <color(5)>Sakomizu<ce()>, so he should be of help to you. That is all from me.

uncertainties.issue: 'shirei' (command/order) rendered 'the order'; <thumbnail(240)> placed directly after it as in the source, which reads a little abruptly in English but preserves tag position.
'honmaru' (the castle keep, i.e. Federation HQ/Lhasa itself) has no locked project term; rendered descriptively as 'home base'. No prior scene uses this metaphor, so nothing to match against.

Compressed from 131 to 116 visible chars to fit the 128 limit by dropping the explicit 'that operation' object of 'join' (now 'join too'); the referent (the Federation fleet sent to 5th Luna, mentioned two rows earlier) is preserved by context.
Source honorific after Asap Suzuki's name (-kun) dropped, consistent with -san being dropped elsewhere in reviewed scenes (4003070); no character identity issue since Asap is locked and male.

checked_decisions: Slot 0 title '17A Defend Federation HQ 2' matches missions_019.json category 3055 slot 190 exactly.
All 18 rows compared against source: no mistranslation, reversed meaning, wrong addressee, invented subject/info, dropped endings, tone contradiction or misspelled name found.
Speaker 30050 = Kouichiro Misumaru throughout (speaker_lookup.py); consistent with 4003030's 'Federation HQ commander' role.
Slots 30-31: 'honmaru' rendered 'home base' per orchestrator ruling; meaning (Lhasa/Federation HQ site being left undefended) is preserved.

Slot 29: 'Federation HQ's home, Lhasa' is an acceptable rendering of 'renpou honbu no aru Rasa' (Lhasa, where Federation HQ is located); does not contradict the distinct 'home base' (honmaru) metaphor used two rows later for a different Japanese word.

Slots 26/27/28: three distinct hostile forces are individually named here - Sakomizu's army (an otherworldly force, slot 26-27), and a former Giganos unit acting in league with Neo Zeon (slot 28), plus Neo Zeon itself (slots 20-22). This is consistent with, and does not contradict, 4003210's 'Tripartite Alliance' (three-party alliance) naming Neo Zeon plus two other parties; nothing in this scene states there are only two hostile factions or otherwise conflicts with a three-party reading.
All <operator>/<speed>/<color>/<ce>/<book>/<endbook>/<thumbnail>/<thumbdown>/<topic> commands verified identical and in the same order as the source for every row.

Names verified against glossary.json/character_names_021.json/sources.json: Char Aznable, Sakomizu (King Shinjiro Sakomizu per 4003030 precedent, male), Lhasa, Londo Bell, Asap Suzuki (honorific -kun dropped per convention), Byston Well, Neo Zeon, Giganos, 5th Luna, Sweetwater - all consistent with locked spellings.
Re-ran throwaway console check after edits: all rows ASCII-only, no newlines, no bare %, no lowercase j/q, all visible text under 128 chars, all command tags identical in order to source.
remaining_uncertainties: Slot 29: 'the order given to us... is the defense of Lhasa' rendered as 'a single order'; the word 'single' is an addition not literally in the source but does not change the fact conveyed (only one order was given). Left as translator's uncertainty.
Slots 30/31: 'honmaru' (castle keep) has no other in-corpus occurrence to compare against; 'home base' is accepted per orchestrator ruling but remains a descriptive, not literal, rendering.
